scope: Local working tree, isolated build; user manager and terminals not restarted.

full_self_test.Name: Tiling: 1–9 windows fill the work area exactly, including odd dimensions and negative origins
Arrangement preferences: every mode fills work area; gaps stay bounded
Selection: fixed sparse slots, high-resolution wheel, cancel and wrap
Alt mouse gestures: wheel routing, AltGr exclusion and middle-click passthrough
Settings: configurable modifiers, valid toggle keys and off-screen placement
Input: connected digits only; Tab toggles inventory and yields when paused or disabled
Agent events: real lifecycle mapping, nested-agent filtering and idle notifications
Persistence: identity, stable task ID, placement, atomic events and corrupt recovery
Win32: enumerate, validate identity, tile/minimize/restore owned fixture
Win32: activating an already focused window raises it above a nonactivating covering window
Win32: hotkey registration and low-level mouse/keyboard/drag hooks
Win32: DWM live preview relationship between owned fixture windows
Integration: capture, rename, external status, move fixed slot, overview and cleanup
Interaction: persistent entrance, immediate hints, direct removal and closed-task history
Hook transport: PowerShell observer emits Unicode event without agent instructions
Recovery: exact matching, ambiguity rejection, startup quoting and saved session metadata
Recovery: repeat suppression, title handshake, stable identity, move and timeout
Recovery: Claude launcher forwards only the specified resume ID
Configuration: nested null fields repaired without losing task identity or original bytes
Configuration: invalid slot structure falls back with byte-preserving backup
Status: age signals uncertainty; long jobs, terminal states and manual marks retain semantics
Inbox: bounded oldest-first backlog, event ordering, retention until acknowledgement
Inbox: rejects malformed, oversized and future events; tolerates locks and nullable text
Portraits: background warmup yields frozen bounded cached images and supports cancellation
Motion: repeated commands preserve transitions and reversal renders intermediate frames
Motion: warm text layouts ignore task renames while changing equipment updates the rendered identity
Overlay: desktop gaps are alpha-zero and native clicks pass to the window underneath
Compact host: native bounds shrink to the ring, deployment preserves the screen anchor
Equipment gesture: dead zone, connected-only release and boundary hysteresis preserve task data
Equipment core: hover opens without focus, desktop gaps retain it, leaving retracts with reentry grace
Radial inventory: fixed sectors, centre cancel, outer cancel and scaled hit testing
Radial inventory: confirm only connected slots; no focus steal, reordering or retained window
Radial inventory: release after a quick chord cancels once and stops its timer
Dock wheel: nine permanent sectors replace the list across skins without changing bindings
Dock equipment: switch cue never takes focus and releases itself after feedback
Skins: all 13 palettes meet body, panel, card and status text contrast >= 4.5
Skins: terminal/native JSON palette contract matches every new skin
Skins: switching and rendering each task state preserves task IDs, launch, session and window snapshots
Skins: family glyphs are distinct and decorations-off renders a clean interactive background
Dock wheel: resize preserves nine hit targets and centre capture resolves to an empty slot
Skins: 13 settings choices use stable enum tags; cancel and save preserve preference boundaries
Skins: nine-card overview remains readable at 780x650 and 200-percent display scaling
Skins: themed settings scroll viewer retains vertical and horizontal scrolling
Skins: short work areas scroll all nine tasks and suppress clipped native thumbnails
Skins: themed slider retains native commands; menu and combo popups honor animation off/on

Legacy migration and restart preserve task identity and chosen weapon
Picker is an isolated draft, supports per-slot choices and fixed short-window actions
Custom import survives original removal; missing, corrupt and unsafe files fall back
Resting 116-DIP core is contained and weapon identity ignores task titles
Reordering a task preserves the remembered current entity after focus leaves managed terminals

Empty slots visibly offer direct add targets without moving existing task positions
Every theme has nine distinct readable entities with explicit provenance
Theme loadouts remain independent and equipment assignment copies value semantics
All theme entities render with fixed targets and no task initials, with decorations on or off
Loadout validation preserves live window bindings, appearance and preferences

wheel_benchmark.metric: UI thread drawing-recording time; excludes OS composition, window activation and screenshot encoding

limitations: Reliability group is included in full self-test; do not count twice.
Warm drawing-recording benchmark excludes end-to-end input, native activation and composition.
Existing switch-cue focus assertion failed once initially; three subsequent full runs passed; cue implementation was not changed.
GitHub workflow added but remote execution not performed.
No long-run or physical mixed-DPI certification.
